Commands-&-Permissions: /spawn.text: Permission: spawn.use (default for everyone) Description: Teleport to spawn

Commands-&-Permissions: /spawn %player%.text: Permission: spawn.others (default for op) Description: Teleport another player to spawn

Commands-&-Permissions: /spawn set.text: Permission: spawn.set (default for op) Description: Sets the spawn at the current location

Commands-&-Permissions: /spawn reload.text: Permission: spawn.reload (default for op) Description: Reloads all files

Commands-&-Permissions: teleport-cooldow.text: Permission: spawn.bypass.cooldown (default for op) Description: Bypass the teleport cooldown

Commands-&-Permissions: teleport-delay b.text: Permission: spawn.bypass.delay (default for op) Description: Bypass the teleport delay

Commands-&-Permissions: cancel-on-move b.text: Permission: spawn.bypass.cancel-on-move (default for op) Description: Bypass the teleport cancel on move

Commands-&-Permissions: void-teleport by.text: Permission: spawn.bypass.void-teleport (default for op) Description: Bypass the void teleport

Commands-&-Permissions: respawn-teleport.text: Permission: spawn.bypass.respawn-teleport (default for op) Description: Bypass the respawn teleport

Commands-&-Permissions: join-teleport by.text: Permission: spawn.bypass.join-teleport (default for op) Description: Bypass the join teleport

Commands-&-Permissions: world-change byp.text: Permission: spawn.bypass.world-change (default for op) Description: Bypass the world change teleport

Commands-&-Permissions: world-list bypas.text: Permission: spawn.bypass.world-list (default for op) Description: Bypass the world-list

Commands-&-Permissions: gamemode-restric.text: Permission: spawn.bypass.gamemode-restriction (default for op) Description: Bypass the gamemode-restriction

Commands-&-Permissions: All permissions.text: Permission: spawn. Description: Grants all permissions of the plugin

Commands-&-Permissions: All bypass permi.text: Permission: spawn.bypass. Description: Grants all bypass permissions

Configuration: update-checks.text: Default value: true Description: Checks for plugin updates on server start

Configuration: list-type.text: Default value: disabled Possible values: disabled : world-list is not used blacklist : the plugin will not work in worlds listed below whitelist : the plugin will only work in worlds listed below Description: Mode that the world-list should use

Configuration: world-list.text: Default values: "none" Example: Description: A list of worlds where the plugin should or should not work

Configuration: gamemode-restricted.text: Default value: false Description: Restrict the usage to specific game modes (only for players teleporting themselves)

Configuration: gamemode-list.text: Default values: "none" Possible values: SURVIVAL, ADVENTURE, CREATIVE, SPECTATOR Example: Description: A list of worlds on which the plugin should or should not work

Configuration: use-player-head-rotation.text: Default value: false Description: Use the player's current head rotation instead of the defined one (spawn location) on teleport

Configuration: fall-damage.text: Default value: false Description: Toggle if the player takes fall damage on teleport

Configuration: teleport-on-join:.text: Default value: false Description: Teleports the player to spawn when joining the server

Configuration: only-first-join.text: Default value: false Description: Teleports the player to spawn only when joining the server for the first time

Configuration: seconds.text: Default value: 3 Description: How long the player has to wait before being teleported to spawn

Configuration: cancel-on-move.text: Default value: true Description: Toggle if the teleport delay should be canceled if the player moves

Configuration: blindness.text: Default value: false Description: Toggle if the player should get the blindness effect during delay Note: this may not work properly with very short delay times.

Configuration: teleport-out-of-void:.text: Default value: false Description: Teleports the player to spawn when falling into the void

Configuration: check-height.text: Default value: -64 Description: The height at which the player gets teleported out of the void

Configuration: teleport-on-respawn:.text: Default value: false Description: Teleports the player to spawn on death

Configuration: ignore-bed-spawn.text: Default value: false Description: Toggle if the bed spawn-point of the player should be ignored

Configuration: ignore-anchor-spawn.text: Default value: false Description: Toggle if the respawn anchor spawn-point of the player should be ignored

Configuration: teleport-on-world-change:.text: Default value: false Description: Teleports the player to spawn if they enter a world other than the spawn world

Configuration: check-on-join.text: Default value: false Description: Toggle if the world should also be checked on join. This can interfere with teleport on join

Configuration: particle.text: Default value: PORTAL Description: Which particles to spawn on teleport Particles: Latest Version / 1.8

Configuration: amount.text: Default value: 40 Description: The number of particles to spawn

Configuration: sound.text: Default value: ENTITYENDERMANTELEPORT Description: Which sound to play on teleport Sounds: Latest Version / 1.9 - 1.21 / 1.8

Configuration: Formatting.text: MiniMessage is supported on 1.18.2+ Paper based servers. Legacy Formatting with & codes is supported on all server types and versions.

Configuration: Features.text: Any message can be disabled by setting it to ''. Remove %prefix% from a message if it should not use it.
